orch update — self-update the global npm install.

Usage: orch update [options]

A second spelling of `orch upgrade`, kept for compatibility: it compares the
running version against the published one and reinstalls the global package
when it is behind. --check only reports the comparison and installs nothing,
which is what a scripted or scheduled caller wants.

Options:
  --check                 Report the latest version; install nothing.
  --dry                   Print the install command; run nothing.

Arguments: none.

Exit codes: 0 up to date or upgraded · 1 the check or the install failed ·
64 usage error.

Examples:
  orch update --check
  orch update
